title: [Main] - User encounters a "record is not open" error when attaching a document to a posted sales shipment in Dynamics 365 (Base Application v28)
summary: Document attachment uploads now work correctly for posted sales shipments and return receipts by adding missing table references and hardening error handling.
key_points: Added Sales Shipment Header and Return Receipt Header cases to GetRefTable in Document Attachment Mgmt
Uploading files from the Documents FactBox on posted sales shipments and return receipts no longer fails with 'The record is not open'
Upload files, Show details and Attach from email in the FactBox now raise a clear error if the source record still cannot be resolved after OnAfterGetRecRefFail
Follows the existing pattern used for Sales Invoice Header and Sales Cr.Memo Header
Regression tests added in W1 and ES test layers
quote: Added the missing Database::Sales Shipment Header and Database::Return Receipt Header cases to GetRefTable, each opening the RecordRef on its table.
